preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
Each test case must have an even number of vertices N between 2 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range from 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the minimum value of k.
The second line of output must contain exactly N/2 unique vertices in set U.
The third line of output must contain exactly N/2 unique vertices in set V.
